headline: MIA @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 4.40 at PHI 4.58, with a projected total of 8.99. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (MIA +0.76, PHI +0.78), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.50, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Liam Hicks, Brandon Marsh, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Owen Caissie, Bryce Harper because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
